components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Forest solid CTA for primary actions (Update, Save, Send).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.35rem;min-height:2.25rem;padding:.4rem .75rem;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #14532d;background:#14532d;color:#f0fdf4;font:500 .8125rem/1.5 "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s ease,border-color .15s ease}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:#166534;border-color:#166534}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,#14532d 55%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Raised bordered control for secondary actions (Edit, Cancel, Build index).
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.35rem;min-height:2.25rem;padding:.4rem .75rem;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #d7ddd9;background:#f6f8f6;color:#1a1f1c;font:500 .8125rem/1.5 "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s ease,border-color .15s ease}.ds-btn:hover{background:#eef1ef;border-color:#c5cdc8}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,#14532d 55%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Forest wash button for quieter accent actions (Think on, Relogin).
components.css: .ds-btn-accent{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:2.25rem;padding:.4rem .75rem;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,#14532d 35%,#d7ddd9);background:#ecfdf5;color:#14532d;font:500 .8125rem/1.5 "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s ease}.ds-btn-accent:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,#ecfdf5 65%,#f6f8f6)}.ds-btn-accent:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,#14532d 55%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Soft danger control for Reset/Delete secondary destructive actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:2.25rem;padding:.4rem .75rem;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,#dc2626 35%,#d7ddd9);background:#fef2f2;color:#b91c1c;font:500 .8125rem/1.5 "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s ease}.ds-btn-danger:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,#fef2f2 70%,#f6f8f6)}.ds-btn-danger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,#14532d 55%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 36×36 compact chrome for refresh, overflow, close, and drawer actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="Refresh"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M15.5 8.2a5.5 5.5 0 1 0 1 3.3"/><path d="M15.5 4.5v3.7h-3.7"/></svg></button>

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Default form control with forest focus ring; 44px min-height at ≤768px.
components.css: .ds-field{display:block}.ds-field-label{display:block;margin-bottom:.375rem;font:500 .75rem/1.45 "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#6b736e}.ds-input{display:block;width:100%;min-height:2.25rem;padding:.4rem .65rem;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #d7ddd9;background:#f6f8f6;color:#1a1f1c;font:400 .8125rem/1.5 "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-input:focus{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,#14532d 45%,transparent);outline-offset:1px;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,#14532d 40%,#d7ddd9)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:#6b736e}

components.name: Sidebar Nav
components.description: Labeled sidebar item; active state uses stage fill + ink (not accent wash).
components.html: BriefSources
components.css: .ds-rail{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.15rem;width:4rem;padding:.35rem 0;background:#f6f8f6;border-right:1px solid #d7ddd9;font-family:"Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-nav-link{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.15rem;width:3.25rem;min-height:2.75rem;margin:.2rem auto;padding:.4rem .2rem;border-radius:6px;color:#6b736e;text-decoration:none;transition:background .15s ease,color .15s ease}.ds-nav-link:hover{background:#eef1ef;color:#1a1f1c}.ds-nav-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,#14532d 55%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-nav-link.is-active{background:#eef1ef;color:#1a1f1c;font-weight:600}.ds-nav-label{max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:.6875rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:.01em}

components.name: Citation Chip
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:1.5rem;min-height:1.5rem;padding:.125rem .375rem;border-radius:9999px;border:1px solid transparent;background:#ecfdf5;color:#14532d;font:600 .75rem/1 "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;vertical-align:baseline}.ds-chip:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,#ecfdf5 65%,#f6f8f6)}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,#14532d 55%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: Askme is a precision local digest tool on sage paper: Linear-dense chrome, Readwise Reader content priority. Public Sans for UI; Newsreader for digest/Insight/article. Forest accent #14532D used sparingly. Brief four-column stage.
keyCharacteristics: Sage stage `#EEF1EF` with raised `#F6F8F6` and `#D7DDD9` hairline borders
Forest accent `#14532D` for primary buttons and progress only
Slim labeled sidebar (~9.5rem); active nav = ink on stage fill
Public Sans chrome + Newsreader reading; system mono for code
English default UI with persistent EN/ZH toggle
SVG logo in the brand slot
Accessibility: skip link, landmarks, live regions, modal focus trap

rules.name: The Forest Sparingly Rule
rules.body: Accent marks actions, selection, and progress—not large background fields or active-nav fills.

rules.name: The Split Face Rule
rules.body: Chrome uses Public Sans; long-form reading uses Newsreader.

dos: Do use Public Sans for chrome and Newsreader for reading surfaces.
Do keep forest accent sparse; keep sage paper (non-white) stage/raised.
Do keep EN default with one-click ZH toggle in the shell.
Do preserve focus-visible outlines on all interactive elements.
donts: Don't reintroduce indigo, pure-white raised panels, or Geist/Inter as the product face.
Don't paint active nav with accent wash by default.
Don't put Newsreader on chrome controls or Public Sans on digest long-form by default.
